summary: Added deterministic live-source mutation observation, typed source-change terminal semantics, stronger retained evidence identity and recovery tests for mutation, permission, decoder and read failures.

review.reviewer: separate grill-code review pass (no independent subagent was available)

startingState.head: df8dd2a01b28d938d644aeadf62adfec50a4c217
startingState.worktree: Tracked files were clean before W12-S05 implementation; ignored campaign state had W12-S04 completed and W12-S05 in_progress, and campaign-state transitions were not included in the scope commit.
startingState.aheadNote: The ahead count includes reachable completed Search scope commits through W12-S04; no upstream changes were present.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning repository's Search mutation guard, diagnostics, retained-evidence handling, tests and contract documentation changed, plus this scope's evidence. No sibling repository, package version, publication state or host/SQL engine source was changed.
implementation.mutationBoundary: Each eligible file is observed before and after processing using length and timestamps plus best-effort Windows volume/file identity. Detected mutation is SEARCH-SOURCE-005/source-changed and cannot be recorded as FilesCompleted or CountsExact.
implementation.evidenceBoundary: Retained context evidence compares bounded source metadata, available file identity and full content hash before and after expansion. Decoder/read failures are typed source-read failures; cancellation and stale-source failures remain distinct.

scenarios: Append, truncate, rename and replacement during a deterministic reader boundary become typed source-change failures.
Permission/open denial, decoder failure and read failure remain typed incomplete outcomes.
Append, truncate, delete, rename and replacement reject later evidence expansion.
Same-content replacement with preserved metadata is rejected through the Windows file identity boundary.
Invalid UTF-8 during evidence expansion becomes a typed source-read failure.

iterationDiagnostics: The first Search test run after adding SEARCH-SOURCE-005 exposed the diagnostics inventory assertion; the catalog test was updated and the complete Search suite then passed.
Windows-specific same-content replacement validation restores metadata and exercises file identity; non-Windows validation uses changed content because no portable inode identifier is claimed.

commands.argv: rg Process/UseShellExecute/ArgumentList/RedirectStandard across Search; git diff --check; JSON parse validation; source manifest and artifact hash validation

gateResults.evidence: The exact Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,596 total tests, 1,562 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the focused Search suite and mutation recovery tests also passed.

The separate review approved mutation accounting, stale evidence handling, typed failures, cleanup and the explicit non-atomic live-tree boundary; exact source hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are retained.
Deterministic append, truncate, rename, replacement, permission/open, decoder and read fault cases never produce a successful complete result, and stale evidence never returns a newer source window.
Source, request, completion, match and scope contract harnesses pass 27 scenarios and 314 assertions, while source-change and read failures carry stable diagnostic codes and terminal reasons.
Mutation validation occurs before file completion, retained evidence validates before and after expansion, decoder/read failures remain typed and no atomic live-filesystem claim is made.

knownLimitations: ScopeExhausted remains an observed live-tree read rather than an atomic snapshot; a mutation after the final check cannot be prevented, and immutable input is required for snapshot semantics.
Non-Windows platforms use metadata checks without claiming a portable inode identifier; an in-place edit preserving every observed metadata value can remain undetected.
The per-file mutation guard adds bounded metadata and identity boundary work; this scope makes no new throughput claim.
The repository suite retained 34 classified skips: 31 expected and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips, plus existing package-audit/compiler warnings.
No package was published, pushed, released or installed, and no sibling repository was edited.
